test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT included in inventory investment when calculating national income?

options.text: Change in sales during the year
Change in stock of raw material
Change in stock of semi-finished goods
Change in stock of finished goods

solution:
The correct answer is __**Change in sales during the year**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Change in sales during the year **is **NOT** included in** inventory investment **when calculating national income.
 
• **Inventory investment **refers to the change in the stock of goods that a company holds over a specific period, typically a year.
 
• It represents the value of goods that have been produced but not yet sold.
 
• Inventory investment is an important **component of a company's balance sheet **and is closely monitored to assess its financial health and efficiency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The options provided relate to different types of inventory that a company might hold:
 
 
• **Change in stock of finished goods:** This refers to the change in the quantity or value of finished products ready for sale that a company holds in its inventory.
 
• **Change in stock of semi-finished goods:** This refers to the change in the quantity or value of goods that are partially processed but not yet ready for sale.
 
• **Change in stock of raw material: **This refers to the change in the quantity or value of materials or components that a company holds to use in its production process.
 
• **Change in sales during the year: **Sales represent revenue generated from selling goods to customers and are not directly related to inventory investment. Therefore, change in sales during the year is not considered part of inventory investment.
